content: 13:1-10 Pol Korin sasam wuri irun wab qamarei
See ye qen ombur gari anit yaribam eng. End munon ombur qo ombur gari qob ger qeemben qamb igamari eng Qenu qob igo gas ende musioruboun.

Munon qomon boru qoan ebetemir eng ne an munon ar qei gor, qen yabt ye yar aninob igo ye mi see ebein end aninob qamam eng. Ne see ye mugenderi e igo bo sabar aninob ete qemerini: ye bo yar aninob igimine munon qomon boru ger ebeiner eng ye me ebesam werinei.
An imbigub qamb eng Munon inubersiau tari wonou ye qabarit di qamb igo. End ne an imbigar, Munon inubersi igo eng wo anit qer me uri igo. Wo qeretutnob anmusub igo.

Apand, qoan eng wo qer uri igama baab nam tenori big waramirei. Ego see Qenu wonou qeretutnob end see igomot igo. End qoan in wonob soriamin end in qer uri igoun. Ego Qenu wonou innonogursia ne in wo nob igomot igoun end anit yarab anqoregensioruboun.

Qenen aninou oau apand eng wariges igoarar. An oau apand eng qeretutnob igo qiyo, ue eng. End aninou wes-wes der aninou qomon sir qerei igoarar. Munon inubersi igo Yisas eng anamar igo eng an qoyam ue e? An musub imbig me qereimunon eng an ue.
Ye mom an imbigoum, an inqereimunon eng in qangang end igoun eng inimbiguboumon.

End an qomon boru obounon qamb ne in Qenu nob qamb igoun. End annonogursi igoriba. In quraun eng, ininou uyes aninou sarau munon diban igoun qamb me quraum. Ue, in qenungoun eng an qomon qoregen toat igamari in munon ar gas ende igorun eng qob ue.
In maigas ebet qob apand eng me bumaimunei. In qob apand eng weregi qamb nonogursiau eng gari werei igo.
In qer uri igumune an qeretutnob igamari eng in uberoruboun. End in qenen Qenu qebi qamb igumune annonogursia Yisas wonou yurau apand igoruboumon.

See ye mugen e igo namanimun qas gumat aninob quraum eng qanam end gari. Qen geret ye is aninob igo bo sabar Munon Aib ye yenonogursia sarau gagam ebet igoum end me anamar qemerinei eng gab. Wo eng yenonogursi igo eng ye der an bo annonogursierin qamb, anbumaimau qamb ue.

Io an yonou munon banam end see qob sasam aninob quraum, an song uber igoarar. An Yisas wonou yurau apand nonoguret igoarar. Ye qob anamar quraum eng toat misir gari big qibanamsi igoarar. Qenu wo Munon uber end antoubar ne oau anmeinseara igoarar.
In Qenu wonou munon yurau end an gari-gari der aninou munon banam ibag sarog big wurinob igoarar.
End in e Qenu wonou yurau eng anit igub uber qamb igour. Munon Aib inubersiau tari Yisas anmusia ne Qenu antoubara ne Igomurur qau an gugum anboopuri ten igoriner.
